rows.accent_source: EXCLUDED — NOT a picker failure. The repo's own SSRF guard refuses the site: lib/crawl/ssrf-guard.ts line 60 reads `if (a === 192 && b === 0) return true;` with the comment '192.0.0.0/24 + 192.0.2.0/24', but that predicate blocks all of 192.0.0.0/16 — and heroku.com resolves to 192.0.66.110, a public Automattic/WP-VIP address. A plain fetch returns HTTP 200; the crawl returns 'resolves to a private address'. Scoring it would measure the guard, not the picker. Re-admit this row once the /16-vs-/24 bug is fixed. Truth if you do: --e-global-color-primary=#5A1BA9 and theme-color #5A1BA9, 85x. (The historic Heroku purple #430098 is served zero times.)
